newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on select buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on select buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday amid selective buying by spinners and dealers said prices were likely to fall on slack demand.
"Overall the market is bearish on low buying as spinners are short of funds," dealer Kishin Chand said. Lack of demand could pull prices further down in the near term, he added.
In the kerb market, K-68 variety was traded at 2,300 rupees ($57.01) per maund (37.32 kg) and MNH-93 at 2,250 rupees per maund, dealers said.
